principle: Every public inference parameter is assigned prospectively to scientific calibration, a conditional branch, numerical equivalence, algorithmic repetition, or an explicitly excluded input. Infinite numeric domains are represented by finite scientifically interpretable levels; no claim of exhaustive mathematical enumeration is made.

inference_parameters.rationale: All semantically distinct weighting rules enter the multigroup design; the single-group branch necessarily uses cell-distance.
Both supported representation spaces are compared.

inference_parameters.domain: integer >= 1, capped by informative matrix rank
inference_parameters.rationale: A preregistered compact, intermediate and broad PCA representation is transferable across eligible panels.
Both supported scaling rules are represented.
All three supported solvers enter the geometry calibration because truncated PCA approximations can change cell distances and therefore inferred-network accuracy; auto is the inherited base level.
Both metrics enter the multigroup design; centered single-group geometry requires Euclidean distance.
Both supported decay families are compared.

inference_parameters.domain: auto or any positive finite real
inference_parameters.rationale: Absolute widths are dataset-unit dependent; the automatic positive-distance median is frozen and its transferable multiplier is calibrated separately.
The finite grid varies smoothing relative to each dataset's automatic distance scale without fitting an absolute unit-specific width.
Both choices enter multigroup balanced and imbalanced conditions; correction is necessarily disabled for a single group.
Both supported estimator families are compared using their library semantics.
The smallest ceiling satisfying the frozen non-inferiority and stability rule is retained.

Named rules, strong randomization and portable fractions including the all-predictor endpoint enter the ordinary estimator screen; all six levels are then crossed over every retained estimator-interaction structure on the independent 1,000-TF transfer panel before any level can be excluded from convergence.
The grid spans no, mild and stronger leaf regularization.
Unbounded and explicitly bounded trees are compared.

inference_parameters.domain: null | false | true; null resolves to the estimator-family default
inference_parameters.rationale: The two effective behaviours are compared; null adds no third behaviour and is excluded as a redundant alias.
Seed is a source of algorithmic replication and is never optimized.

optional_inputs.domain: optional file containing a non-empty subset of expression genes
optional_inputs.rationale: The intended application has no target list; deriving one from simulator truth would leak outcome information.
Annotation-confidence weighting is an application-specific adaptation considered only after the synthetic benchmark and is not part of any benchmarking claim.

operational_parameters.rationale: Thread counts are checked for deterministic equivalence and measured for cost, not selected by accuracy.
The backend controls execution scheduling and memory use, not the scientific model. Auto is the benchmark default; backends must preserve fixed-seed outputs and are not selected by accuracy.
Report generation must not change inferred networks.
Checkpointing must not change completed outputs.
A resumed run must equal an uninterrupted run.
Progress rendering must not alter model results.

parameters.rationale: Minimum analysis-unit size belongs to input eligibility, not inference tuning.
The benchmark starts from simulator-prepared matrices and does not tune H5 filtering.
The only supported first-version normalization is fixed.
A conventional fixed library-size scale is declared rather than outcome-tuned.
Identifier choice is a data-identity operation and cannot change biological values.
Duplicate handling is an explicit data contract, not an inference hyperparameter.

preparation_parameters.rationale: The synthetic article benchmark evaluates the inference method on already prepared expression matrices. Generic H5 preparation remains reproducible but is outside the accuracy-calibration estimand.
